Guidance for Claude Code (claude.ai/code). Native SwiftUI iOS Hotlympics face-rating app.

open ios-app.xcodeproj
xcodebuild -project ios-app.xcodeproj -scheme ios-app -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro' build
xcodebuild test -project ios-app.xcodeproj -scheme ios-app -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro'
xcodebuild clean -project ios-app.xcodeproj

Bundle ID: hotlympics.ios-app. Preferred Simulator: iPhone 16 Pro. Dependencies: Firebase Auth, Firebase Storage, Google Sign-In (via Swift Package Manager). After making changes, build the project and fix any warnings or errors. Test on iPhone 16 Pro simulator.

Entry: `App/ios_appApp.swift` (Firebase, Google URL schemes). Tabs: Rating (unrestricted swipe pair rating), Leaderboard (unrestricted Glicko-2 scores), Upload/My Photos/Profile (authenticated + complete profile).

Services: `auth/FirebaseAuthService`; `data/ImageQueueService`; `api/RatingService`; `data/ImagePreloader`; `api/UploadService`; `data/UserService`; `MyPhotosViewModel`; `UploadViewModel`. Components include Rating (`SwipeCardView`, `ImagePairView`, `SwipeIndicatorView`, `ImageElementView`), Upload (`UploadView`, `PhotoSourcePickerView`, `CameraView`, `UploadProgressView`, `ImageCropperView`/controller), Photos (`MyPhotosView`, `PhotoGridView`, `PhotoCellView`, `PoolSelectionBarView`, `EmptyPhotosView`), Auth (`SignInView`, `SignInPromptView`, `ProfileSetupView`, `GenderDOBSetupView`, `TermsOfServiceView`), shared `CachedAsyncImageView`.

Flows: queue blocks/prefetching, ratings, auth reset, 400x400 crop, compression, signed upload/confirmation, cache refresh, OAuth/profile sync. Base URL: `https://hotlympics-server-670297845147.us-central1.run.app` in Constants.swift. Bearer token from Firebase Auth is added when available.
